job.prompt: Create a clean UI mockup illustration of an AI chat assistant interface embedded on a B2B product page. The right side shows a chat window with a conversation: a buyer message bubble says 'Do you have VDE-certified insulated screwdrivers for the European market?' and the AI assistant responds with a product recommendation card showing a small product thumbnail, product name, key specs (voltage rating, certification), and a prominent blue 'Request Quote' CTA button. The left side shows a partial product page with specifications table. Modern chat bubble design with blue (#0d93e8) accent, rounded corners, clean white background, subtle drop shadows. Professional SaaS product screenshot style, not a 3D render. 16:9 aspect ratio.
